designs.title: No.
designs.why: Strong, legible lockup from 3 m: the cat draped over a heavy slab 'NO', the paw resting on a ball that doubles as the full stop is a smart typographic joke, and the shared baseline rule ties it together. Cat linework (scowling face, hatched tail) is confident and prints well in one ink on both tees. Weak points: the white stripes inside the letters are irregular and jittery, so the N and O read as busy, shaky block type rather than tabby fur, and they fight the clean outline cat; the letterforms themselves are generic; the tail crowds the N's left stem; and the ball sits tight to the O so the 'No.' period reads more as a toy than punctuation.
designs.fix: Redraw the stripes inside N and O as fewer, deliberate tabby bands with a consistent rhythm and taper (or drop them for solid letters) so the type is calm and the cat stays the focal point.
